text:
alana (product): Need a compact rollout playbook for next week's routing change. Focus: clear gates, per-step owners, and a minimal rollback ladder.

matt (eng): Proposed ramp: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Canary windows: 30m then 2h. Abort on hard SLOs.

jordan (sre): SRE thresholds: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increase >25% vs baseline (and p95 > 1.2s) -> pause + alert.

tara (cs): Customer rule: any top-10 customer with >2x latency or repeated errors -> hold and notify CS lead. Need per-tenant holdback toggle.

matt (eng): Add a fallback variant (model-v1-fallback) to route to on issues instead of full revert. Also default VIP tenants to old route for first two ramps.

jordan (sre): Rollback ladder (automated steps): 1) throttle slice to 10% and switch to fallback; 2) if persistent after 15m revert slice to model-v1; 3) if still failing kill flag and rollback globally.

matt (eng): Draft rollout YAML for Console: ```yaml
flag: routing_cutover_q3
steps:
 - pct: 0.5
   duration: 30m
   checks: ["5xx < 0.5%","p95_delta < 25%"]
 - pct: 5
   duration: 2h
 - pct: 20
   duration: 2h
 - pct: 100
   duration: 1h
fallback_variant: model-v1-fallback
vip_holdback: true
auto_rollback: false
rollback_ladder: [throttle_and_fallback, revert_model_slice, kill_flag_global]
```

alana (product): Add owners per step: engineer_oncall, product_lead, cs_rep and SLAs: SRE acts within 5m, CS contacts customers within 10m.

jordan (sre): I'll add runbook hooks and automated Slack pings. Alert example: `ALERT: routing_cutover_q3 | region=eu-west | p95=2.1s | action=throttle+fallback`.

tara (cs): I'll prepare VIP list and customer note. Need the per-tenant toggle in Console exposed to CS.
\almatt (eng): (typo) noted — will expose toggle and upload playbook.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled - routing_cutover_q3 staged rollout start=2024-07-18T16:00Z (canary).

alana (product): Decision: default to pause + scripted rollback (auto_rollback=false) but allow opt-in for fully automated rollback for trusted experiments. Dry-run scheduled with oncall + CS.
